projects.name: GMC Math Trainer
projects.summary: Step-by-step practice for the VU GMC mathematics course: matrices, complex numbers, eigenvalues and limits. Problems are generated fresh each time and every step is checked. Lithuanian and English.

projects.name: Vilnius Moto Routes
projects.summary: Motorcycle rides that start and end in Vilnius, each with a road book, GPX files for Kurviger and buttons for Google Maps and Waze.
